name: historical_civilizations
description: Identify historical civilizations or empires from their rulers; no date or arithmetic questions.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
facts=[('Augustus','Roman'),('Nero','Roman'),('Trajan','Roman'),('Hadrian','Roman'),('Ramesses II','Egyptian'),('Tutankhamun','Egyptian'),('Hatshepsut','Egyptian'),('Khufu','Egyptian'),('Cyrus the Great','Persian'),('Darius I','Persian'),('Xerxes I','Persian'),('Suleiman the Magnificent','Ottoman'),('Mehmed II','Ottoman'),('Osman I','Ottoman'),('Justinian I','Byzantine'),('Basil II','Byzantine'),('Genghis Khan','Mongol'),('Ogedei Khan','Mongol'),('Moctezuma II','Aztec'),('Atahualpa','Inca'),('Pachacuti','Inca')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(4):
 for ruler,civilization in facts:
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white']);stem=f'Historical ruler: {ruler}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['Name the civilization or empire this ruler belonged to. Answer:','Which civilization or empire did this ruler govern? Answer:','Identify the historical civilization associated with this ruler. Answer:','Give the name of this ruler\'s civilization or empire. Answer:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+civilization});control.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the marker? Answer:','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
